name: launch_editor
description: Launch Godot editor for a specific project

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

name: run_project
description: Run the Godot project and capture output. Starting a run stops the previous one. The game runs with Godot's local debugger, so a runtime script error pauses it at a "debug>" prompt that get_debug_output shows.

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

args.description: Optional: Arguments for the game, e.g. ["--battle=1009"]. They are passed after "--", so the game reads them with OS.get_cmdline_user_args() and they cannot change engine options.

harness.description: Optional: Run the game under the godot-mcp harness main loop so capture_screenshot and simulate_input work (default: true). Nothing is written to the project. Set false for a project with its own main loop type.

embedded.description: Optional: macOS only (default: false). Run the game with no window, through Godot's undocumented --embedded editor mode. It never takes focus, get_global_mouse_position() follows simulate_input so warpMouse is not needed, and capture_screenshot works with nothing on screen. Needs the harness.

name: run_scene
description: Run a specific Godot scene and capture output. Starting a run stops the previous one. The game runs with Godot's local debugger, so a runtime script error pauses it at a "debug>" prompt that get_debug_output shows.

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene to run, as a res:// path or a path relative to the project

timeoutMs.description: Time in milliseconds before the scene is stopped automatically (default: 30000)

args.description: Optional: Arguments for the game, e.g. ["--battle=1009"]. They are passed after "--", so the game reads them with OS.get_cmdline_user_args() and they cannot change engine options.

harness.description: Optional: Run the game under the godot-mcp harness main loop so capture_screenshot and simulate_input work (default: true). Nothing is written to the project. Set false for a project with its own main loop type.

embedded.description: Optional: macOS only (default: false). Run the game with no window, through Godot's undocumented --embedded editor mode. It never takes focus, get_global_mouse_position() follows simulate_input so warpMouse is not needed, and capture_screenshot works with nothing on screen. Needs the harness.

name: capture_screenshot
description: Capture a PNG of what the game started by run_project or run_scene is rendering right now, returned as an image. The image is in the game's viewport coordinates, the ones node positions use, so with stretch mode canvas_items or viewport it has the project's base size whatever the window size. Fails for a headless game or a window that is minimized, hidden or covered, and times out while a script error holds the game at a "debug>" prompt.

savePath.description: Optional: Absolute path of a .png file to also write the screenshot to

name: simulate_input
description: Send mouse, keyboard and input action events to the game started by run_project or run_scene, one command after another, and return the screenshots taken along the way. Positions are in the game's viewport coordinates, the same pixels capture_screenshot returns. The sequence stops at the first command that fails.

commands.description: Commands to run in order: click {x, y, button?, double?}, mouse_move {x, y}, mouse_drag {from_x, from_y, to_x, to_y, button?}, key {key, modifiers?}, action {action, pressed?}, action_pulse {action, duration_ms?}, text {text, delay_ms?}, wait {duration_ms?}, screenshot {}

key.description: Godot key name such as "A", "Space", "Enter", "Escape", "Up" or "F5". A name such as "Ctrl+S" also works.

action.description: Input action from the project's Input Map, or a built-in one such as "ui_accept"

pressed.description: Press or release the action (default: true)

duration_ms.description: How long action_pulse holds the action, or how long wait waits (default: 100)

warpMouse.description: Optional: Also move the real mouse cursor to each position (default: false). Only needed when the game reads the cursor with get_global_mouse_position() or get_mouse_position(). It moves the cursor on the desktop.

timeoutMs.description: Optional: How long to wait for the whole sequence in milliseconds (default: 30000)

name: get_debug_output
description: Get the output, errors and status of the last run_project or run_scene process. Works while it runs and after it exits, crashes or times out, until the next run or stop_project. Keeps the last 1000 lines of each stream.

name: stop_project
description: Stop the Godot process started by run_project or run_scene and return its final output

name: run_gut_tests
description: Run GUT tests (res://addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd) and wait for the result. With no test or dir it runs what .gutconfig.json lists. Passing test runs only those scripts. Fails when GUT reports failures or exits non-zero.

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

test.description: Optional: res:// test scripts to run, e.g. ["res://test/unit/test_battle.gd"]. The .gutconfig.json dirs are skipped unless dir is also given.

dir.description: Optional: res:// directories to search for tests instead of the .gutconfig.json dirs, e.g. ["res://test/unit"]

unitTestName.description: Optional: Only run tests whose name contains this text (-gunit_test_name)

select.description: Optional: Only run scripts whose file name contains this text (-gselect)

innerClass.description: Optional: Only run inner test classes whose name contains this text (-ginner_class)

includeSubdirs.description: Optional: Search subdirectories of dir (default: true)

headless.description: Optional: Run without a window (default: true). Use false for tests that need rendering.

timeoutMs.description: Optional: Stop the run after this many milliseconds (default: 600000)

name: get_godot_version
description: Get the installed Godot version

name: list_projects
description: List Godot projects in a directory

directory.description: Directory to search for Godot projects

name: get_project_info
description: Retrieve metadata about a Godot project

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

name: create_scene
description: Create a new Godot scene file

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Path where the scene file will be saved (relative to project)

rootNodeType.description: Type of the root node (e.g., Node2D, Node3D)

name: add_node
description: Add a node to an existing scene

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Path to the scene file (relative to project)

parentNodePath.description: Path to the parent node (e.g., "root" or "root/Player")

nodeType.description: Type of node to add (e.g., Sprite2D, CollisionShape2D)

properties.description: Optional properties to set on the node

name: load_sprite
description: Load a sprite into a Sprite2D node

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Path to the scene file (relative to project)

texturePath.description: Path to the texture file (relative to project)

name: export_mesh_library
description: Export a scene as a MeshLibrary resource

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Path to the scene file (.tscn) to export

outputPath.description: Path where the mesh library (.res) will be saved

meshItemNames.description: Optional: Names of specific mesh items to include (defaults to all)

name: save_scene
description: Save changes to a scene file

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Path to the scene file (relative to project)

newPath.description: Optional: New path to save the scene to (for creating variants)

name: get_uid
description: Get the UID for a specific file in a Godot project (for Godot 4.4+)

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

filePath.description: Path to the file (relative to project) for which to get the UID

name: update_project_uids
description: Update UID references in a Godot project by resaving resources (for Godot 4.4+)

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

name: view_log
description: View recent console output from the editor started by launch_editor, such as script parse errors. Returns the last N lines of captured stdout and stderr. For run_project and run_scene output use get_debug_output.

lineCount.description: Number of trailing lines to return (default 50, max 1000)

name: quit_godot
description: Close the Godot editor that was launched by this MCP server via launch_editor. Only closes editors spawned by this server. Unsaved changes in that editor are lost.
